name: max_slot_wal_keep_size
description: Limits the maximum disk space (in MB) that replication slots may reserve for WAL files in pg_wal; negative values disable the limit.
symptoms: replication slot failure due to WAL retention violation
unintended WAL recycling causing replica divergence
tuning_tips: Set to a positive value only when you need to bound WAL retention for replication slots and have predictable replica lag; monitor pg_replication_slots.active and pg_stat_replication to avoid exceeding the limit.
